theme.title: Mixed / Stock-Picker's Market
theme.summary: Consumer Staples (+2.31%) and Materials (+2.28%) led the market today, while Energy (-1.60%) and Technology (-1.20%) brought up the rear. Performance didn't cluster cleanly by style — growth averaged +0.71%, defensives +1.50%, and value/cyclicals +0.46% — more a stock-by-stock market than a single broad theme. That shows up at the index level too: the blue-chip Dow gained +1.30% while the tech-heavy Nasdaq fell +0.07%, a wide enough gap to matter. Small caps underperformed as well, with the Russell 2000 at +0.10%, hinting the move favored large, established balance sheets over smaller, more rate-sensitive companies. The VIX fell 3.48% to 18.02, which reads as an orderly rotation rather than panic-driven selling. Gold slipped 0.29% to $4,038.00, crude oil was little changed at $78.49, and bitcoin gained 0.34% — cross-asset moves weren't all pointing the same direction as equities.
